skipped.description: The request matched an existing deployment and no new one was created

action.description: Requested action: stage, activate, or restart. Defaults to activate unless overriding. Without override, the exact action must be permitted by the garden's direct policy, including windows and confirmation requirements; restart does not require override. Required explicitly when overriding policy.

force.description: Deploy even when an identical closure was already deployed

override.description: Break glass: bypass deployment policy on both server and garden. Requires override permission, action, reason, and a connected garden advertising override support. Unsupported gardens are rejected with an upgrade-required error. Seed/action support and activator privileges still apply.

reason.description: Why policy is being bypassed. Recorded in the audit trail.
